title: Dubai got rich moving other people's stuff
hook_variants: Dubai isn't rich because of oil. Not anymore.
Oil is only a tiny slice of Dubai's economy. So where's the money from?
Dubai makes money from things it doesn't even make.

scenes.say: Dubai isn't rich because of oil. Not anymore.
Oil today is only a small slice of Dubai's economy. The real engine? Moving stuff.
Goods arrive from Asia, get stored tax-free, then ship out to Africa, Europe and the Middle East.
Jebel Ali, the biggest port in the Middle East. Free zones. Low taxes. A giant airline hub.
Dubai doesn't need to make the product. It takes a cut every time it passes through.
Follow Landed Costs to see where the money really flows.

caption:
Oil is a small slice of Dubai's economy today. Its real engine: trade, re-exports, free zones and one of the world's biggest ports. 🏙️🚢
